source.note: Full text of ASME BPVC Section II, Part B (Nonferrous Material Specifications) — SB-676 - Standard Specification for UNS N08367 Welded Tube — as supplied by Daniel Velasquez on 2026-09-07 and extracted from the supplied PDF with marker-pdf. `data` is the extractor's output verbatim — the drop's own `document`, `part`, `figures` and `pages` blocks, with the page-by-page block tree, its HTML, tables and layout coordinates unedited. This file IS the source document, so `transcribed_from` names its own path: it is the artefact under review, not a transcription of one. The volume was supplied as one combined PDF and cut into parts at its own headings, so this file is a page-range slice of a single extraction and its page ids (PDF pages None–None, no printed page numbers on these pages) are the combined document's own, not renumbered from 0. Front matter (cover and title page, contents, list of sections, foreword, statement of policy, personnel, correspondence, summary of changes, cross-referencing) and back matter (back cover) were deleted from the drop before supply and are NOT filed; the drop's `content.json`, `index.json`, `meta.json` and `README.md` are retained beside the kind folders, unfiled, for the same reason. The edition — 2025 Edition (ASME BPVC.II.B-2025), issued 2025-07-01 — is stated on the title page, which this drop no longer carries as a filed cut: it survives only inside the retained `content.json`, so no filed cut of this standard prints its own edition. This cut carries no figure.

specification.title: Standard Specification for UNS N08367 Welded Tube
specification.equivalence_note: Identical with ASTM Specification B676-03(2014) except that certification has been made mandatory.

children.html: (Identical with ASTM Specification B676-03(2014) except that certification has been made mandatory.)
[Identical with ASTM Specification B 676-03(2014) except certification has been made mandatory.]
1.1 This specification covers UNS N08367 welded tube for general corrosion applications.
1.2 This specification covers outside diameter and nominal wall tube.
1.2.1 The tube sizes covered by this specification are 1 ⁄ 8 to 5 in. (3.2 to 127 mm) in outside diameter and 0.015 to 0.320 in. (0.38 to 8.13 mm), inclusive, in wall thickness.
1.3 The values stated in inch-pound units are to be regarded as the standard. The values given in parentheses are for information only.

1.4 This standard does not purport to address all of the safety concerns, if any, associated with its use. It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to become familiar with all hazards including those identified in the appropriate Material Safety Data Sheet for this product/ material as provided by the manufacturer, to establish appropriate safety and health practices, and determine the applicability of regulatory limitations prior to use.

2.1 ASTM Standards: A 1016/A 1016M Specification for General Requirements for Ferritic Alloy Steel, Austentic Alloy Steel, and Stainless Steel Tubes B 751 Specification for General Requirements for Nickel and Nickel Alloy Welded Tube B 899 Terminology Relating to Non-ferrous Metals and
3.1 Terms defined in Terminology B 899 shall apply unless otherwise defined in this standard.
4.1 Material furnished in accordance with this specification shall conform to the applicable requirements of Specification B 751 unless otherwise provided herein.
5.1 Class 1 — Welded, cold worked, solution treated, and each piece of each lot subjected to one of the following four tests: hydrostatic, pneumatic (air underwater), eddy current, or ultrasonic.
5.2 Class 2 — Welded, cold worked, solution treated, and each piece of each lot leak tested (hydrostatic or pneumatic) plus electric tested (eddy current or ultrasonic).

6.1 It is the responsibility of the purchaser to specify all requirements that are necessary for material ordered under this specification. Examples of such requirements include, but are not limited to, the following:
6.1.1 Alloy name or UNS number, 6.1.2 ASTM designation and year of issue,
6.1.3.1 Outside diameter and nominal wall thicknesses,
NOTE 1 — Tube produced to outside diameter and minimum wall thickness may be furnished upon agreement between the manufacturer and the purchaser.
6.1.5 Quantity (feet or number of pieces),
A Iron shall be determined arithmetically by difference.
6.1.7 Samples for Product (Check) Analysis— State whether samples for product (check) analysis should be furnished, and

6.1.8 Purchaser Inspection— If the purchaser wishes to witness tests or inspection of material at the place of manufacture, the purchase order must so state indicating which tests or inspections are to be witnessed.

7.1 Tube shall be made from flat-rolled alloy by an automatic welding process with no addition of filler metal. Subsequent to welding and prior to final solution treatment Class 1 and Class 2 material shall be cold worked either in both weld and base metal or in weld metal only.
NOTE 2 — The recommended heat treatment shall consist of heating to a minimum temperature of 2025°F (1105°C) for Type N08367 and quenching in water or rapidly cooling by other means.
7.2 Tube shall be furnished with oxide removed. When solution treatment is performed in a protective atmosphere descaling is not necessary.
8.1 The material shall conform to the requirements as to chemical composition prescribed in Table 1. One test is required for each lot as defined in Specification B 751.
8.2 If a product (check) analysis is performed by the purchaser, the material shall conform to the product (check) analysis variations specified in Specification B 751 Table 2.
9.1 Mechanical Properties— The material shall conform to the mechanical properties prescribed in Table 2. One test is required for each lot as defined in Specification B 751.
9.2.1 One flattening test per lot shall be performed in accordance with Specification B 751.
9.3.1 Flange test specimens shall show no cracking or flaws.
9.3.2 For tube less than 0.093 in. (2.36 mm) in inside diameter and tube having a wall thickness equal to or greater than the inside diameter, the flange test shall not be required.
9.4.1 One reverse-bend test as defined in Specification A 1016/A 1016M shall be performed on each lot of tubing.
9.4.2 Reverse-bend test specimens shall show no evidence of cracks or lack of penetration in the weld, or of overlaps resulting from the reduction in thickness of the weld areas by cold working.

9.4.3 The reverse-bend test is not applicable when the specified wall is 10% or more of the specified outside diameter, or the wall thickness is 0.134 in. [3.4 mm] or greater, or the outside diameter size is less than 0.375 in. [9.5 mm]. Under these conditions the reverse flattening test of Specification A 1016/A 1016M shall apply.
9.4.4 The lot definition for the reverse-bend test shall be 1500 ft [450 m] of finished tubing.
9.5.1 Tube shall be subjected to a pressure test or nondestructive electric test in accordance with Specification B 751.
10.1 Certification shall be supplied as a mandatory requirement per SB-751.
